mapper.select: SELECT FROM `${tableName}` ORDER BY `trade_date` DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM `${tableName}` ORDER BY `trade_date` DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM `${tableName}` WHERE `code` = #{code} AND `trade_date` <= #{date} AND `adjustflag` = #{adjustFlag} ORDER BY `trade_date` DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MIN(`trade_date`) AS `firstDate`, MAX(`trade_date`) AS `lastDate`, COUNT(*) AS `rowCount`, COUNT(DISTINCT `trade_date`) AS `tradingDays`, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `adjustflag` ORDER BY `adjustflag`) AS `adjustFlags`, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT `data_source` ORDER BY `data_source`) AS `dataSources` FROM `${tableName}` WHERE `code` = #{code}
SELECT `adjustflag` FROM `${tableName}` WHERE `code` = #{code} AND `adjustflag` IS NOT NULL GROUP BY `adjustflag` ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, `adjustflag` LIMIT 1

INSERT INTO `${tableName}` (`code`,`market`,`trade_date`,`open`,`close`,`high`,`low`,`preclose`,`volume`,`amount`, `amplitude`,`pct_chg`,`chg_amt`,`turnover`,`adjustflag`,`tradestatus`,`is_st`, `pe_ttm`,`pb_mrq`,`ps_ttm`,`pcf_ncf_ttm`,`data_source`) VALUES
(#{item.code},#{item.market},#{item.tradeDate},#{item.open},#{item.close},#{item.high},#{item.low}, #{item.preclose},#{item.volume},#{item.amount},#{item.amplitude},#{item.pctChg},#{item.chgAmt}, #{item.turnover},#{item.adjustFlag},#{item.tradeStatus},#{item.isSt},#{item.peTtm},#{item.pbMrq}, #{item.psTtm},#{item.pcfNcfTtm},#{item.dataSource})
